# Per-fixture benign-delta allowlist for the
# e2e-fidelity-compare-fmt-consumer gate.
#
# Consumer-mode fidelity diffs the consumer .o (testdata/fidelity/
# consumers/fmt_consumer.cpp compiled twice: once against cmake's
# installed fmt headers, once via Bazel against the converted
# //:fmt target). The four entries below are C++ template
# instantiations that the Bazel-side compile emits at .o-level
# while the cmake-side compile inlines them away (or vice versa).
#
# Same benign category as the lib-side fmt allowlist — inlining
# decisions differ between the cmake distro toolchain and Bazel's
# hermetic toolchain, neither is wrong; the converter's exposure
# of fmt's public headers is correct on both sides.

# basic_string_view<char> constructor (complete + base) — bazel-side
_ZN3fmt3v1117basic_string_viewIcEC1EPKc
_ZN3fmt3v1117basic_string_viewIcEC2EPKc
# detail::make_arg<custom, context, double> — bazel-side
_ZN3fmt3v116detail8make_argILb1ENS0_7contextEdLi0EEENS1_5valueIT0_EERT1_
# detail::make_arg<custom, context, int> — bazel-side
_ZN3fmt3v116detail8make_argILb1ENS0_7contextEiLi0EEENS1_5valueIT0_EERT1_
